content.text: I'll start by gathering the current state of all three routers in parallel.
Let me gather the current state from all three routers simultaneously.

input.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
from netmiko import ConnectHandler

routers = {
    "HQ": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.6", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
    "Branch1": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.5", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
    "Branch2": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.7", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
}

commands = [
    "show interfaces",
    "show ip ospf neighbor",
    "show ip route",
    "show configuration commands | grep ospf",
    "show configuration commands | grep protocols static",
    "show configuration commands | grep 'interface eth\\|interface lo'",
]

for name, params in routers.items():
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  {name} ({params['host']})")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    conn = ConnectHandler(**params)
    for cmd in commands:
        print(f"\n--- {cmd} ---")
        print(conn.send_command(cmd))
    conn.disconnect()
PYEOF

| # | Router | Issue |
|---|--------|-------|
| 1 | HQ | eth0 IP is 10.10.**10**.1/22, should be 10.10.**0**.1/22 |
| 2 | HQ | OSPF network `10.10.0.0/21` should be `10.10.0.0/22` |
| 3 | HQ | Missing OSPF default-information originate |
| 4 | Branch2 | eth2 is Admin Down |

python3 << 'PYEOF'
from netmiko import ConnectHandler

# Fix HQ
hq = ConnectHandler(device_type="vyos", host="192.168.122.6", username="vyos", password="test")
cmds = [
    "configure",
    # Fix eth0 IP: 10.10.10.1 -> 10.10.0.1
    "delete interfaces ethernet eth0 address 10.10.10.1/22",
    "set interfaces ethernet eth0 address 10.10.0.1/22",
    # Fix OSPF network statement for eth0
    "delete protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.0.0/21",
    "set protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.0.0/22",
    # Add default-information originate
    "set protocols ospf default-information originate always",
    "commit",
    "save",
]
print("=== HQ FIX ===")
output = hq.send_config_set(cmds)
print(output)
hq.disconnect()

# Fix Branch2
b2 = ConnectHandler(device_type="vyos", host="192.168.122.7", username="vyos", password="test")
cmds = [
    "configure",
    # Enable eth2
